texts.zh:
[From.GetName]轨道上的船壳是维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的残骸，它是一艘巨大的亚光速世代舰船，属于名为马达克·沃尔的非常唯心主义的外星物种。

尽管船上的生命已被无情地清除，舰长日志中仍然详细记录了马达克的悲惨之旅。在遭到被称为“躯壳”的可怕存在围追堵截之后，他们逃离了故乡，寻找遥远的乐园星球——传说中的乐土帕丽达雅，它只会对获选者显露真面貌。不过以其舰船的状况来看，他们被攻击者追上了。

我们是否该提取舰船的导航设备，并解密其目的地？
texts.en:
The hulk orbiting [From.GetName] is all that remains of the Vechtar Zavonia, a massive sub-light generation ship belonging to a deeply religious alien race called the Mardak Vol.

Though the ship has been ruthlessly purged of all life, the Mardaks' ill-fated journey has been detailed in the captain's logs. After being hunted to near extinction by nightmarish beings referred to as 'Vessels', they fled their homeworld in search of a distant paradise planet - the mythical promised land Paridayda, that would reveal itself only to the chosen ones. Judging by the state of their ship, however, their attackers caught up with them.

Shall we extract the ship's navigational drive and decrypt its destination?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 一个早已消逝的外星物种的巨型世代舰船，其导航设备中可能藏有一颗完美星球的坐标。
texts.en: A massive generation ship belonging to a long dead race of aliens may hold the encrypted location of a utopian planet within its navigational drive.

texts.zh:
解开维克塔·泽沃尼亚号的导航设备加密并不轻松，但多亏了对寻找马达克·沃尔族的理想乡着迷的首席科学官[vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]，我们最终成功了。

更令人担忧的是，这一发现不知怎的被透露给了公众，人们现在和[vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]一样决心要在一颗乐园星球上安家。
texts.en:
Cracking the encoding algorithms on the Vechtar Zavonia's navigational drive was no small feat, but thanks to head researcher [vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName], who seems to have developed an unusual obsession with finding the Mardak Vol's utopian world, we have finally succeeded.

More worryingly, the discovery has somehow leaked to the public who now share [vechtar_zavonia_leader_name.GetName]'s fixation with settling a paradise planet.

label.zh: 没有什么能阻止我们进入乐园。
label.en: Nothing can keep us out of paradise.

label.en: A fleet enters the revealed system

label.zh: 终止计划。这是徒劳之举。
label.en: Abort. This is a fool's errand.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。

texts.zh: 一个早已消逝的外星物种的巨型世代舰船，其导航设备中可能藏有一颗完美星球的坐标。
texts.en: A massive generation ship belonging to a long dead race of aliens may hold the encrypted location of a utopian planet within its navigational drive.

texts.zh:
第二次，继而再三确认导航系统的坐标后，我们不得不承认马达科-沃尔的天堂行星是一个只有荒原的荒芜星球。

尽管我们不能排除这种可能性：马达科所认为的天堂与我们的常识不同，但[utopian_planet.GetName]表面上的弹坑给出了另一种答案。这艘船的船长和乘员并没有简单的就接受了挫折。
texts.en:
After double- and triple-checking the navigational drive's coordinates, we have been forced to concede that where the Mardak Vol's paradisaical planet should have been are only the desolate plains of a barren world.

Though we cannot eliminate the possibility that the Mardaks' idea of paradise was wildly different to our own, the bomb-scarred surface of [utopian_planet.GetName] tells a different story. The ship's captain and crew have not taken the disappointment lightly.

label.zh: 这不可能！再去确认一次坐标！！
label.en: This cannot be! Quadruple-check the coordinates!!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗乐园星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that paradise planet appears here.

texts.zh: 只要发射一个探测器，我们就将最终揭开谜底：眼前这颗毫无生机的荒芜行星是否就是马达科-沃尔传说中的天堂。
texts.en: Sending a probe to the planet's surface will allow us to decide once and for all whether the desolate barren world that lies before us is in fact all that remains of the Mardak Vol's mythical paradise.

texts.zh:
我们终于发现了马达科-沃尔的秘密！

当我们把探测器向[utopian_planet.GetName]的地表发射时，它仅仅触碰到大气层就被弹开了，这让船员们怀疑其中另有隐情。进一步深入的研究发现我们所看见的星球表面仅仅是一层能量护盾，向外投射着荒芜废土的假象，而在这护盾背后，一颗生机勃勃的盖亚星球藏匿其中，证实着马达科-沃尔的传说所言非虚。

不仅如此，当船员们降下护盾时，他们还发现了一个由一种哺乳动物和真菌的共生体组成的石器时代的文明，平和地生活在他们简陋的聚落中，对刚刚发生的一切和我们的存在一无所知。而传说中梦魇般的“血裔”，也仅仅在他们的口口相传中继续存在。
texts.en:
We have finally uncovered the Mardak Vol's secret!

It was when a probe, destined for the planet's surface, bounced off its atmosphere that the crew began to suspect [utopian_planet.GetName] was not what it seemed. Closer studies revealed that what looked like the planet surface was in fact an energy shield, upon which a barren world's texture was projected, and hidden below it, a lush Gaia planet reminiscent of the Mardaks' prophecies.

But that isn't all! As the crew deactivated the shield they discovered a peaceful stone age civilization consisting of a symbiotic union between mammals and fungi who live in crude huts, oblivious to the outside world. The nightmarish 'Vessels' live on only as mythical beings in their legends.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗乐园星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that paradise planet appears here.

texts.zh: 我们终于在马达克·沃尔族的乐园星球帕丽黛达上安家了。人们正在欢庆，因为有一天，他们的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]也能在[utopian_planet.GetName]的沙丘、花园与清泉中嬉戏！
texts.en: We have finally settled the Mardak Vol's paradise world, Paridayda, and our citizens are rejoicing at the thought that one day their [From.Owner.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural] too may frolic among the sandy dunes, lush gardens and crystal springs of [utopian_planet.GetName]!!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种的称呼。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗乐园星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that paradise planet appears here.

texts.zh: [country_that_discovered_mardak_vol.GetName]在我们领地内的一颗盖亚星球上，发现了一个隐秘的[GetPreFTLLower]文明。星球似乎被某种复杂的能源护盾保护，使它看起来像是一颗死寂星球。我们尚未判明是谁以及为什么将它藏起来，因为那些[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种明显没有足够的科技实力。他们似乎是哺乳动物与菌类形成的某种共生关系，而且在我们看来，他们完全无害。
texts.en: The [country_that_discovered_mardak_vol.GetName] has discovered a secret [GetPreFTLLower] society hidden on a Gaia planet within our borders. The planet seems to have been shielded by some sort of sophisticated energy field, making it appear as if it were a barren world when it was not. We have yet to determine who hid it and why, as the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] clearly lack the technology for it themselves. They seem to be a sort of symbiotic union between fungoid and mammal and, as far as we can tell, they are utterly harmless.

label.zh: 判断一颗星球绝不能只看表面。
label.en: Never judge a planet by its cover.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现相关帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the empire's name appears here.

texts.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的远古马达克·沃尔族。事情似乎非常紧急。
texts.en: We are being hailed by a previously unencountered species of sapient mammal regarding the ancient Mardak Vol still residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

texts.zh: 一个先前从未遭遇过的智慧哺乳动物联络了我们，事关仍居住在[utopian_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种。事情似乎非常紧急。
texts.en: We are being hailed by a previously unknown species of sapient mammal regarding the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] residing on [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems very urgent.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗乐园星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that paradise planet appears here.

texts.zh:
你好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们是沃尔族，我们和平而来。

我们发现你们的一颗星球感染了马达克。它是一种寄生性真菌生物，千百年来一直危害着我们一族，将其宿主变成傀儡，而你们就是它的下一个目标！

我们本以为已将其彻底消灭，但我们的年度星系扫描却发现[utopian_planet.GetName]上还存活着许多。但不用担心，我们知道该怎么办……
texts.en:
Well met, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We are the Vol and we come in peace.

We have discovered that one of your planets has been infested with Mardak. It is a parasitic fungoid that has preyed upon our kind for eons, turning its hosts into mindless puppets, and you are its next targets!

We thought we had eradicated it for good when our annual galaxy scan revealed a thriving population on [utopian_planet.GetName]. But fear not, we know just what to do...

label.zh: 无稽之谈，他们人畜无害！
绝不允许你们伤害他们！

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对方物种的称呼。
note.en: In the game, the other species' name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗乐园星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that paradise planet appears here.

texts.zh:
注意：我们将开始轨道灭绝协议倒计时，3，2，1……已向感染者释放空气传播菌类溶剂-X。敌对媒介已被清除！

不要担心，你侦测到的任何环境变化都不是暂时的，而且无法恢复……

我们感谢你们的合作。

我们是沃尔族，我们和平而来。

和平……
texts.en:
Be advised: We are commencing orbital extermination protocols in 3, 2, 1...Air-borne dissolvent Fungo-X released onto infected populations. Hostile agents neutralized!

Do not be alarmed, any environmental changes you may be registering are not temporary and completely irreversible...

We thank you for your cooperation.

We are the Vol. We come in peace.

Peace...

texts.zh: 频道里只有杂讯。我们失去了与沃尔族的联络。
texts.en: The channel crackles and pops. We have lost our connection with the Vol.

texts.zh:
原始的[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]！当你醒来时发现马达克镶进你的[From.GetSpeciesOrganName]时会有何感想？菌类首先会控制你的神经系统，然后一个细胞接一个细胞地控制你的全身！你的血肉会开裂，你的精神会随之崩溃！

幸运的是，[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，那一天永远不会到来。我们不会允许它发生的。

我们是沃尔族。我们将……和平归来。
texts.en:
Basic [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]! How do you think you will like it when you wake up with Mardak lodged in your [From.GetSpeciesOrganName]s, and your flesh is crawling and your mind cracking as the fungus hijacks first your nervous system, then your entire body, cell by cell?

Lucky for you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult], that day will never come to pass. We cannot allow it.

We are the Vol. We will return...in peace.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对方物种的贬称。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对方物种的一个身体部位。
note.en: In the game, a body part of the other species appears here.

texts.zh:
我们侦测到了一支敌方舰队，带着沃尔族的通讯特征，正笔直前往[utopian_planet.GetName]。看来他们是为仍居住在星球上的马达克而来……

他们没有回应我们的联络。
texts.en:
We have detected a hostile fleet, bearing the Vol communications signature, headed straight for [utopian_planet.GetName]. It seems they have come for the Mardak still living on the planet...

They are not responding to our hails.

label.en: The Vol fleet bombs the planet to zero pops

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗乐园星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that paradise planet appears here.

texts.zh: 沃尔族在帝国安全方面可不敢有丝毫的大意，在他们用自己的全部核武力量攻击帕丽达雅并将马达克·沃尔族那美丽富饶的家乡变为一片焦土之后，沃尔族在地表的焦土上洒下杀真菌剂，彻底消灭了马达克·沃尔族。不管马达克是否有危险性，那寄生的真菌体已经不复存在了。
texts.en: The Vol do not gamble with national security. After unleashing their entire nuclear arsenal upon Paridayda, turning the Mardak Vol's formerly lush homeworld into ash, they doused the fiery wreckage in fungicide, dissolving the last remains of the Mardak Vol into a toxic slush. Dangerous or not, the parasitic fungoids are no more.

note.en: The Vol nuke and poison the planet.

summary.text:
# 维克塔·泽沃尼亚号 / The Vechtar Zavonia

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1056-1085; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:685 (distar.1000); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:963 (GENERATION_SHIP); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:734 (distar.1001); common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:73 (vechtar_zavonia_system); common/event_chains/00_event_chains_distant_stars.txt:36-45; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1007; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:814 (distar.1002); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:988 (HIDDEN_PLANET); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:875 (distar.1003); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:1024 (distar.1004); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:1045-1100 (distar.1007, 1010); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:1105-1369 (distar.1005-1013); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2199; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:1575-1661 (distar.1015, 1016); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1303; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:1692 (distar.1014)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。气态巨行星可能生成“远古船壳”（8级，全局一次，权重0.35，null_spawn_chance 0.65）；玩家物种使用 mam5 或 fun4 头像（沃尔人/马达克人外形）、格式塔或游牧帝国不会遇到。

Requires Distant Stars. Gas giants can spawn "Ancient Hulk" (level 8, once per game, weight 0.35, null_spawn_chance 0.65); not for empires whose species uses portrait mam5 or fun4 (the Vol / Mardak look), gestalts or nomads.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.1000“维克塔·泽沃尼亚”：宗教种族马达克·沃尔的亚光速世代舰残骸，他们为躲避“容器”的追杀，寻找只向选民显现的乐园 Paridayda，但仍被追上。可开启 GENERATION_SHIP（60天）→ distar.1001“隐蔽星球”：解密航行目的地，首席研究员变得偏执，公众也开始向往乐园。继续 → 开启“维克塔·泽沃尼亚号”事件链，生成一个新星系（含 utopian_planet）并标出兴趣点；放弃 → 影响力。
2. 舰队进入该星系 → distar.1002“失乐园”：坐标处只有一颗满是弹坑的荒芜星球。坚持 → HIDDEN_PLANET（60天）→ distar.1003“完美世界”：荒芜外表是能量护盾投影，下面是盖亚星球，住着石器时代的马达克·沃尔（哺乳类与真菌的共生体）；星球被命名为 Paridayda。
3. 若星系属于他国，10天后 distar.1004 通知该国；20天后（或之后有人在该星系建前哨时，隐藏 distar.1007）隐藏 distar.1010 让星系主人收到 distar.1005：自称“沃尔”的种族来电——distar.1006 称马达克是寄生真菌。同意“用火净化” → distar.1008 灭绝星上马达克人口（追问环境变化 → distar.1013 断线）；拒绝（或真菌物种保护他们）→ distar.1009 威胁，60–80天后 distar.1011 沃尔舰队前来，以“末日”轰炸直到人口归零 → 隐藏 distar.1015 → distar.1016“失乐园”。
4. 发现者若殖民 Paridayda，distar.1014“身处乐园”给予10年修正。

1. distar.1000 "The Vechtar Zavonia": the wreck of the Mardak Vol's sub-light generation ship; fleeing the "Vessels", they sought the paradise Paridayda that reveals itself only to the chosen, but were caught. GENERATION_SHIP (60 days) → distar.1001 "Hidden Worlds": the destination is decrypted, the lead researcher becomes obsessed and the public dreams of paradise. Continue → the "Vechtar Zavonia" chain starts and a new system with the utopian planet and a point of interest is spawned; abort → influence.
2. A fleet entering that system → distar.1002 "Paradise Lost": only a bomb-scarred barren world. Insist → HIDDEN_PLANET (60 days) → distar.1003 "Postcard Perfection": the barren surface is a projected shield over a Gaia world inhabited by stone-age Mardak Vol (a mammal–fungus symbiosis); the planet becomes Paridayda.
3. If another empire owns the system, it gets distar.1004 after 10 days; after 20 days (or when someone later builds an outpost there, hidden distar.1007) the hidden distar.1010 gives the system owner distar.1005: the "Vol" hail us — distar.1006 calls the Mardak a parasitic fungus. "Purge them with fire" → distar.1008 exterminates the Mardak pops (asking about environmental changes → distar.1013, the line goes dead); refusing (or a fungoid empire protecting them) → distar.1009 threats, then 60–80 days later distar.1011 a Vol fleet arrives and bombards the planet to zero pops → hidden distar.1015 → distar.1016 "Paradise Lost".
4. If the discoverer colonises Paridayda, distar.1014 "In Paradise" grants a 10-year modifier.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.1001、1002 的继续/放弃互斥；distar.1006 的净化与拒绝通向互斥结局（1008 灭绝 / 1011→1016 星球被焚毁）。1004 仅在星系属于他国时出现。

Continue/abort in distar.1001 and 1002 are exclusive; distar.1006's purge vs refuse lead to exclusive endings (1008 extermination / 1011→1016 the world burned). distar.1004 only appears when another empire owns the system.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.1006.c“绝不允许你们伤害他们”仅限真菌物种帝国；distar.1005 有两段正文。

distar.1006.c "You will not harm them!" is for fungoid empires only; distar.1005 has two texts.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常、distar.1000–1016、两个项目、事件链及 on_entering_system_fleet / on_building_starbase_outpost / on_colony_zero_pops / on_colonized。修正：草稿把一条故事拆成五个（异常、event-distar-1002、1007、1014、1015）；现合并为以异常为根的故事，并以审阅连接表示进入隐藏星系、沃尔舰队轰炸致人口归零、殖民 Paridayda。

Checked the anomaly, distar.1000–1016, both projects, the event chain and the on_entering_system_fleet / on_building_starbase_outpost / on_colony_zero_pops / on_colonized hooks. Correction: the draft split one story into five (the anomaly, event-distar-1002, 1007, 1014, 1015); merged with reviewed links for entering the hidden system, the Vol bombardment and colonising Paridayda.
